content.short: Coin98 Super Wallet is a non-custodial wallet for managing assets, using dApps, and moving across many chains including TON.
content.description: Coin98 Super Wallet is a non-custodial product for storing tokens and NFTs, connecting to dApps, and moving assets across multiple blockchain ecosystems. The app includes wallet creation, transfers, swaps, bridging, and in-app browsing tools that support a broad cross-chain workflow. TON is one of the supported networks, so Coin98 is best understood here as a general purpose wallet that includes TON access rather than a wallet designed only for the TON ecosystem, with most of its product scope extending far beyond TON.
content.meta: Coin98 Super Wallet combines wallet, swap, bridge, and dApp access features with support for TON assets and many other chains.
